dishes.name: Meefischli
dishes.desc: Small river fish rolled in flour and fried crisp, eaten whole with lemon and bread. A Würzburg Main-valley specialty.

dishes.name: Fränkischer Presssack
dishes.desc: Pressed cold-cut of pork head in aspic, dressed with vinegar, oil and onions. Eaten on bread in Lower Franconian taverns.

dishes.name: Rhön lamb
dishes.desc: Meat of the Rhön sheep, grazed on mountain meadows, roasted or braised in Rhön inns.

dishes.name: Franconian Bratwurst
dishes.desc: Grilled pork sausage seasoned with marjoram and served in a roll, a staple of Würzburg and Lower Franconian markets.
